cat > /tmp/check_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash regions="us-east-1 us-east-2 us-west-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1 eu-west-2 eu-west-3 eu-central-1 eu-north-1 ap-northeast-1 ap-northeast-2 ap-northeast-3 ap-southeast-1 ap-southeast-2 ap-south-1 sa-east-1 ca-central-1" echo "Checking all subnets for network interfaces..." echo "" subnets_with_no_eni=() for region in $regions; do echo "Checking region: $region" # Get all subnets in the region subnets=$(aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId, VpcId, CidrBlock, AvailabilityZone, Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0]]' --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$subnets" ]; then echo " No subnets found" continue fi while IFS=$'\t' read -r subnet_id vpc_id cidr az name; do [ -z "$subnet_id" ] && continue # Get count of network interfaces in this subnet eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$eni_count" = "0" ] || [ -z "$eni_count" ]; then echo " Found empty subnet: $subnet_id (Name: $name, VPC: $vpc_id, AZ: $az, CIDR: $cidr)" subnets_with_no_eni+=("$region:$subnet_id:$name:$vpc_id:$cidr:$az") fi done <<< "$subnets" done echo "" echo "================================" echo "Summary: Subnets with no network interfaces" echo "================================" if [ ${#subnets_with_no_eni[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "All subnets have at least one network interface." else for item in "${subnets_with_no_eni[@]}"; do IFS=':' read -r region subnet_id name vpc_id cidr az <<< "$item" printf "Region: %-15s | Subnet ID: %-20s | Name: %-30s | VPC: %-15s | CIDR: %-15s | AZ: %-20s\n" "$region" "$subnet_id" "$name" "$vpc_id" "$cidr" "$az" done fi EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_subnets.sh /tmp/check_subnets.sh

cd /workspace/alchemy && for file in .alchemy/alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/*.json; do kind=$(jq -r '.kind' "$file") if [[ "$kind" == "AWS::EC2::Instance" ]]; then id=$(jq -r '.id' "$file") vpcId=$(jq -r '.output.VpcId' "$file") region=$(jq -r '.output.region' "$file") state=$(jq -r '.output.State' "$file") echo "$id|$vpcId|$region|$state" fi done

cat > /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash cd /workspace/alchemy # Get all VPCs with their IDs echo "=== All VPCs ===" declare -A vpcs for file in .alchemy/alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/*.json; do kind=$(jq -r '.kind' "$file") if [[ "$kind" == "aws::Vpc" ]]; then id=$(jq -r '.id' "$file") vpcId=$(jq -r '.output.vpcId' "$file") region=$(jq -r '.output.region' "$file") vpcs[$vpcId]="$id|$region" echo "Resource ID: $id | VPC ID: $vpcId | Region: $region" fi done # Get all instances and their VPCs echo "" echo "=== EC2 Instances and their VPCs ===" declare -A instance_vpcs for file in .alchemy/alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/*.json; do kind=$(jq -r '.kind' "$file") if [[ "$kind" == "AWS::EC2::Instance" ]]; then id=$(jq -r '.id' "$file") vpcId=$(jq -r '.output.VpcId' "$file") region=$(jq -r '.output.region' "$file") state=$(jq -r '.output.State' "$file") # Only count instances in managed VPCs (not the default VPC) if [[ "$vpcId" != "vpc-default" ]]; then instance_vpcs[$vpcId]=$((${instance_vpcs[$vpcId]:-0} + 1)) fi echo "Instance: $id | VPC: $vpcId | Region: $region | State: $state" fi done # Find VPCs with no instances echo "" echo "=== VPCs with no EC2 instances ===" empty_vpcs=() for vpcId in "${!vpcs[@]}"; do count=${instance_vpcs[$vpcId]:-0} if [[ $count -eq 0 ]]; then empty_vpcs+=("$vpcId") fi done if [[ ${#empty_vpcs[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then echo "No empty VPCs found. All VPCs have at least one EC2 instance." else echo "The following VPCs have no EC2 instances:" for vpcId in "${empty_vpcs[@]}"; do region=$(echo "${vpcs[$vpcId]}" | cut -d'|' -f2) echo " - VPC ID: $vpcId (Region: $region)" done fi echo "" echo "=== Summary ===" for vpcId in "${!vpcs[@]}"; do resId=$(echo "${vpcs[$vpcId]}" | cut -d'|' -f1) region=$(echo "${vpcs[$vpcId]}" | cut -d'|' -f2) count=${instance_vpcs[$vpcId]:-0} echo "VPC: $resId ($vpcId) in $region - $count instances" done EOF chmod +x /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh
